title: Large Multigenerational Family, Brick Porch - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait capturing a multi-generational American family of thirteen people posed outside a brick residence under sharp sunlight. The family includes grandparents, adult siblings, teenagers, and young children in the front row. The women wear tailored wartime-era dresses with structured shoulders, floral prints, and Victory rolls or soft waves, while the men wear dark three-piece and two-piece suits. The young children in front wear casual mid-1940s playwear, including a floral pinafore-style dress, suspenders, and a sailor-collared suit.
